description: Capture a full-page PNG screenshot of any public URL, returned inline as a base64 data:image/png URI ready to drop into an tag. One endpoint, three capture tiers - normal and advanced at 1 credit, ultra for the hardest sites at 5. Only a successful capture is billed. Returns url, image, image_format, mode and image_bytes.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent execute the browser workflow deterministically with explicit checkpoints?
Did the agent verify final browser state with concrete evidence?
